verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents managing multiple instances and tenants through named CLI profiles so users can switch between environments, and plans include multiple tenants. This gives separate non-production workspaces, and `hatchet worker dev` runs workers locally. However, there is no documented dedicated sandbox or test mode, and nothing that guarantees isolation of production data; separation depends on the user setting up a separate tenant or instance. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment feature, documented data isolation between test and production tenants, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: the `hatchet profile` commands allow you to manage multiple Hatchet instances and tenants with named profiles, making it easy to switch between different environments
the `hatchet worker dev` command lets you run a worker locally with automatic reloading when code changes are detected
